So the Prime Minister succeeded in the 1990s by the Leader of the Conservative Party: Margaret Thatcher. Need evidence.

However need evidence that she was succeeded by the Leader of the Conservative Party (John Major). We have evidence that Major became leader and PM in November 1990. That implies succession. So we can cite that.

Thus answer: Margaret Thatcher.
